bundle.shortDescription: Offline, interactive recPhyloXML / NHX phylogenetic-reconciliation viewer
bundle.longDescription: PhyloRecViewer draws recPhyloXML and NHX phylogenetic reconciliations (species tree plus reconciled gene trees with speciation, duplication, loss and transfer events) as a deterministic, publication-ready SVG. It runs fully offline and exports SVG, PNG, PDF, interactive HTML, CSV and NHX, with search, filtering, statistics, consistency checks, nested and side-by-side comparison views, and bilingual (English / 中文) interface.

fileAssociations.name: recPhyloXML / phyloXML (XML)
fileAssociations.description: reconciled gene tree in an .xml or .phyloxml container (generic .xml files may also open in other applications)
